subject: Kickoff: Light Field Neural Rendering productization
body:
Hi all,

Kicking off LFNR for the vision portfolio. Our open-source JAX/Flax implementation of Light Field Neural Rendering produces very strong novel views on reflective/shiny scenes, and the product hook is 3D product photography for commerce partners — a handful of camera captures in, smooth view interpolation out.

Milestones for the window:
- Mar 20: toy-task demo run green on our infra, environment reproducible from requirements.txt.
- Apr 17: shiny-dataset reproduction (the NeX release set), with dataset.base_dir wired to our storage rather than the external drives.
- May 22: quality bar review — PSNR parity with the paper on at least 6 of 8 scenes — feeding the Launch Review Board slot in early June.

Santiago owns staffing/compute; Katya is tech lead. Note the LRB is biweekly and sign-off is required before any external demo, so the May date is firm.

Lucia
